_readme: Boston lookbook photos. Drop files into public/lookbook/ and fill in src, alt and caption. Empty src shows a labeled frame. Captions are first person, written by the person in the photo. Never use stock or AI-generated images.

home-hero.want: Wide shot, 1-3 people in EF merch in a Boston place people recognize (Esplanade, Harvard Bridge, North End, Hult Cambridge campus). Landscape for desktop; the crop keeps the center for phones.

home-who.want: Close portrait, one person wearing a tee, looking at the camera.

rand-worn.want: Someone wearing a Paul Rand Option tee, full print visible.

story-today.want: A group of classmates, candid, outdoors in Boston.

hult-capsule.want: Hult students on or near campus. No merch needed: the capsule is a concept.

product-on-person.want: Any tee worn, waist-up, plain background. Shown on product pages as 'On a person'.
